name: vela
description: Plan in Claude, straight into your Vela coaching account — and onto your athletes' watches through intervals.icu.
long_description:
Lets Claude read your exercise library and your clients' reports, draft and create programmes in your Vela account, and change them day by day. It assigns a programme, moves a session or sends a client's sessions to her intervals.icu calendar only when you ask it to.

Runs can carry watch steps, so they reach a Garmin, Coros or Suunto as structured workouts through intervals.icu.

You need a personal API key: in Vela, open Settings → API keys, create one, and paste it here.
